title: Create an Upgraded Smart+ Streaming Search Ads Campaign for Web
content_data:
This article walks you through the steps to create an Upgraded Smart+ Streaming Search Ads Campaign for Web. This campaign type dynamically leverages your entertainment catalog products to populate and deliver targeted web ads. To configure this campaign type, set `catalog_enabled` to `true` and `catalog_type` to `TRAVEL_ENTERTAINMENT` at the campaign level. Additionally, specify the entertainment catalog by passing the `catalog_id` at the ad group level. By integrating Streaming Ads, the system will automatically generate diverse ad creatives, including catalog videos and single videos. # Prerequisites Creating Streaming Search Ads Campaigns for Web requires setting up an entertainment catalog in Business Center first. To set up the catalog: 1. Create an entertainment catalog using [/catalog/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-a-catalog/v1.3). >

Note: The entertainment catalog is currently an allowlist-only feature and is invitation-only because this catalog type is under Alpha Testing. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. However, acceptance into the Alpha Test is not guaranteed. 2. Upload products to the catalog using [/catalog/product/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-products-via-a-json-schema/v1.3) (JSON schema), [/catalog/product/file/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-products-via-a-file-url/v1.3) (CSV feed template), or [/catalog/feed/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-a-feed/v1.3)(online data feed schedule). 3. Check the product handling results. - For CSV feed and JSON schema, use [/catalog/product/log/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-product-handling-log/v1.3). - Pass in the `feed_log_id` obtained from Step 2. If the field `error_affected_products` in the response is not null, examine the issue details and return to Step 2 to reupload the product. - For online feed, use [/catalog/feed/log/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-log-of-a-feed/v1.3). - Pass in the `feed_id` obtained from Step 2. If the field `error_count` in the response is not 0, examine your online feed and return to Step 2 to reupload the product. 4. Confirm that the catalog contains one or more available catalog products via the value of `approved` returned from [/catalog/overview/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-overview-of-a-catalog/v1.3). Only available products can be delivered in your ads. The minimum number of required available catalog products varies based on your desired ad format: - If you want to use the Single Video or Catalog Video ad format, ensure the catalog contains at least one available catalog product. - If you want to use the Catalog Carousel ad format, ensure the catalog contains at least two available catalog products. 5. (Optional) Create a product set using [/catalog/set/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-a-product-set-by-conditions/v1.3).
If you want to have products selected from a product set, creating a product set is necessary. Otherwise, you can skip this step. 6. (Optional) Invite members to Business Center and grant the Admin permission using [/bc/member/invite/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/invite-members-to-a-bc/v1.3).
You can also choose `advertiser_role` that you want to assign to the members invited. 7. (Optional) Share a catalog with members and grant catalog management access using [/bc/asset/assign/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/assign-an-asset/v1.3).
Make sure to specify `CATALOG` in the `asset_type` field and `ADMIN` in the `catalog_role` field. # Steps ## 1. ### Customize the ad format combinations in Upgraded Smart+ Streaming Search Ads Campaigns for Web If you enable auto-selection of catalog creatives (`catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`), the system will automatically create ads using combinations of two possible formats: catalog video, and single video. The possible ad format combinations for your Streaming Search Ads Campaigns for Web are illustrated in the following table. ```xtable |Is the catalog video format available?{30%}|Is the single video format available?{30%}|Ad format combination for your Streaming Search Ads Campaigns for Web{40%}| |---|---|---| |✅|❌|catalog video| |✅|✅|catalog video and single video| ``` To ensure certain ad formats are available in Streaming Search Ads Campaigns for Web, follow the instructions in the following table. ```xtable |Ad format{20%}|Ad format description{25%}|How to ensure the ad format is available{23%}|How to configure the parameters{32%}| |---|---|---|---| |catalog video|Generate a dynamic video based on information from the product catalog|The catalog needs to be bound to at least one video template or you need to configure a video URL for each catalog product.
The system will automatically select one of your video templates for each catalog product to generate the corresponding catalog video or use the video URL for the catalog product.|Ensure that at least one video template is bound to your catalog (`catalog_id`) or a video URL (`video_url`) has been configured for each catalog product.

  • To ensure a video URL has been configured for each catalog product, use [/catalog/product/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-products/v1.3) and check the returned `video_url`.
    • If you want to add video URLs for your catalog products, use [/catalog/product/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/update-products/v1.3).
  • To ensure that at least one video template (video package) is bound to your catalog, use [/catalog/video_package/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-video-packages/v1.3).
    • To learn about how to create video templates on TikTok Ads Manager, see [How to create video packages in a Catalog](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/how-to-create-video-packages-in-a-catalog).
